 The manuscript that S. sent to Hunt in August 1819 did not provide the text for the poem’s
first publication in 1824. It is probable that Mary used a fair copy of her own, made either later
in the autumn or in spring 1820. Harvard Nbk lists ‘Maddalo and Julian’ on the contents page,
but the transcript has been removed, probably to provide press-copy for 1824. A transcript of
lines 1–107 (in Mary’s hand and again entitled ‘Maddalo and Julian’) survives in Nbk 11 ff. The fair copy S. sent to Hunt (Hunt MS) became the property of S. R. Townshend Mayer at
Hunt’s death. Mayer made it available to H. B. Forman who used the MS as copy text in Forman
